title: E-commerce Website Cost in India
seoTitle: E-commerce Website Development Cost in India (2026)
seoDescription: What an e-commerce website costs in India: Shopify vs custom, payments, GST invoices, Tally and courier integration. Cost bands, timelines and drivers.
summary: An e-commerce website in India typically costs ₹1 lakh to ₹4 lakh on Shopify or WooCommerce with a customised theme, ₹4 lakh to ₹12 lakh with custom design and integrations such as Tally, couriers and WhatsApp, and ₹12 lakh or more for a fully custom store or B2B ordering portal.

costBands.includes: Shopify or WooCommerce, customised theme, payments, shipping, basic SEO
Custom design, Tally and courier integration, WhatsApp updates, analytics
Dealer pricing, credit limits, bulk ordering, ERP integration

dataPoints.label: Running costs
dataPoints.value: Platform subscription, apps, payment gateway fees (around 2% on most methods), hosting

dataPoints.label: Biggest cost drivers
dataPoints.value: Custom design, integrations, catalogue size, B2B pricing rules

dataPoints.label: Must-haves
dataPoints.value: GST-correct invoices, COD handling, fast mobile pages

dataPoints.label: Growth add-ons
dataPoints.value: WhatsApp cart recovery, reviews, marketplace sync

body:
## Platform or custom

Shopify and WooCommerce suit most D2C brands. Custom commerce makes sense for B2B ordering with dealer-specific pricing, credit limits and ERP integration. See [software for retail and D2C brands](/blog/software-for-retail-and-d2c-brands) and our [Tally and Shopify integration guide](/integrations/tally-shopify).

These ranges are indicative for 2026, based on the effort such projects typically take. Your quote depends on your scope, integrations and quality requirements; a short discovery phase turns this into a firm number.

faqs.q: Is Shopify good for Indian stores?
faqs.a: Yes, with Indian payment gateways, COD and GST set-up; watch app subscription costs.

faqs.q: Do we need an app as well?
faqs.a: Usually not at first; a fast mobile website converts well. Add an app when repeat customers justify it.
